items.title: Krispy Kreme CEO details turnaround strategy after earnings
items.summary: Krispy Kreme (DNUT) CEO Joshua Charlesworth joins Josh Lipton on Market Domination to break down the donut maker's latest earnings and discuss the progress of its turnaround strategy.

items.title: Target Q2 results to offer key test of recovery, says UBS
items.summary: Target Corp (NYSE:TGT)’s second quarter results will provide a key test of whether the retailer’s recent turnaround is gaining lasting momentum, with UBS analysts expecting comparable sales growth to accelerate on a two-year basis despite tougher year-ago comparisons. items.title: Elf Beauty Expands Into Hair Care Products
items.summary: Elf Beauty Chief Executive Officer Tarang Amin says the company is excited about expanding into hair care products. It launched a new partnership with Target in June. Amin talks about that and the latest earnings report on "Bloomberg The Close."

items.title: Do Wall Street Analysts Like Target Stock?
items.summary: Target has outperformed the broader market over the past year, and analysts are moderately optimistic about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: This Retail Expert Likes Tapestry, Ralph Lauren, Gap, and Off-Price Chains
items.summary: A resilient consumer and product “newness” are driving up retail stocks. Dana Telsey, founder of Telsey Advisory Group, shares her favorite names.

items.title: Amazon says it will share $600 million in Trump tariff refunds with some of its customers — will you get a payout?
items.summary: Of the $166 billion in tariff refunds available, $71 billion has been claimed by companies, but very little of the refund money has gone directly to consumers.

items.title: Consumers Keep Hitting Buy on THC Despite Federal Restrictions
items.summary: Americans are buying THC seltzers at Total Wine while Congress debates re-criminalizing them. RYTHM’s blowout quarter shows who’s winning.

items.title: Elf Beauty stock climbs as Bernstein upgrades on strong hair care launch
items.summary: Investing.com -- Bernstein upgraded Elf Beauty to Outperform from Market-Perform and nearly doubled its price target to $113 from $60, citing a stronger-than-expected start to the company’s newly launched hair care line.
